senses.gloss: m. pl. (a comp. of מוֹי a. נוּנָא; Versions vary, betw. מוני׳, מֵינוּ׳ a. מֵנוּ׳) fish-brine, small fish in brine; in gen. brine.
units: Keth. 60ᵇ דאכלה מ׳ וכ׳ a woman that eats moniné (during pregnancy) will &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:16">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ מ׳ וצחנתא וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 172:1">Yalk. Kings 172</cite> <he>מ׳ דצ׳</he>) even brine and (Yalk.; brine of) hashed fish he used to taste and give to the poor.
Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ מ׳ לתעניתא (Ms. M. נוניני) m. is good to eat after fasting.
